title: Files
question: Which file manager layout fits best? (You can combine them.)

variants.label: Drive
variants.notes: Google Drive style: places on the left (Home, Root, Recent, Starred, Trash, bookmarks, SFTP remotes, disk usage). Folders as chips, files as cards with real previews. Details panel on the right with a clickable permission grid.

variants.label: Table + preview
variants.notes: Power-user layout: tabs for several folders, editable path, dense table with owner and permissions, multi-select with a floating action bar, live preview of text files with Edit.

variants.label: Columns + transfers
variants.notes: Finder-style columns to move through the tree fast, preview in the last column, drag-and-drop upload zone and a transfer queue with progress at the bottom.
